paper: LettuceDetect: A Hallucination Detection Framework for RAG Applications (arXiv:2502.17125, KRLabsOrg)
benchmark: RAGTruth (Niu et al., ACL 2024) — vendored, data/ragtruth_protocol/
entry_point: HallucinationDetector.predict_prompt(prompt, answer) — the call that matches preprocess_ragtruth.py's HallucinationSample(prompt, answer); predict(context=[...], question=...) re-wraps via PromptUtils.format_context and is NOT the RAGTruth path
